html:
SMTO-CTX-0004 — This step needs more room than the model has

GUID: d3e3e383-1faf-4e69-ad69-a9f4f6947639
Slug: system-tools-protected-input-exceeds-context-window
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • Each step sends the model SMTO's built-in instructions, the list of tools it can use, and your current request. Even after leaving out older messages and shortening tool output, these didn't fit, so the model wasn't asked.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the Main model, then Limits and recovery. If Context ceiling has a number smaller than the model supports, clear it so it says Auto. A limit set too low makes SMTO think the model has less room than it really does.
  2. Open Settings › Agent behavior › Advanced and, under Tool result preview, lower Head characters and Tail characters. Shorter tool output previews leave more room, and the change applies at the task's next model step.
  3. Start a new task with a shorter request or fewer attached files, or choose a model that can hold more text as Main. The instructions and tool list can't be removed, so the rest of the request has to be smaller or the model bigger.

What success looks like

  • The task gets past this step and the model replies without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; the details show how much room each part needed. Don't raise Output allowance; it leaves even less room for the request.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Context preparation failed before inference: system instructions, required tool schemas and protected current input still exceed the context window minus reserved output after history pruning and automatic tool-preview reduction.

What this means

  • Required instructions, tool definitions and protected current input still exceed available context after eligible reductions. These components cannot simply be discarded without changing the meaning or safety of the request. Locally estimated counts identify a budget check, not a provider rejection.

Why this can happen

  • The total retained input plus output reservation exceeds effective context capacity. No single component is established as the sole cause.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the recorded system, tool and protected-input component counts with the total. Their component estimates guide narrowing the task; they are not exact independent provider measurements.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the error facts from native/compaction.py prepare_context (input_tokens_after_compaction, context_window_tokens, reserved_output_tokens, component estimates). Verify context_window_tokens for the routed role matches the served capacity, lower tool_result_preview, reduce current input, or route to a larger-context model; system instructions and required tool schemas cannot be dropped, and raising max completion tokens only reduces input headroom. If that is not enough, select a model with a larger real context window.
  • Reduce the current task input or use a model with a larger real context window. Mandatory system instructions and required tool schemas cannot be dropped to force the request to fit.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Confirm the next request passes context preflight.
  • Confirm existing completed tool results and receipts remain preserved without replay.

What not to do

  • Do not increase max completion tokens as the primary fix; reserving more output reduces input headroom.
  • Do not claim an inference response occurred when the model request did not start.

Technical notes

  • This capacity branch occurs before the next inference request starts. Prior tool receipts are preserved and token estimates retain provenance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0003 — Your current request is too big for the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together
  • SMTO-CTX-0006 — Your request is too large for SMTO to plan the task
  • SMTO-CTX-0007 — Provider tokenizer rejected context
  • SMTO-CTX-0008 — This task's saved model settings don't match the model
